title: An Open-Domain Avatar Chatbot by Exploiting a Large Language Model
reason: The paper appears to be an avatar-based conversational system in an immersive setting. That is more spatially situated than plain text chat, but it still does not read like a multi-agent social simulation.

title: Artificial intelligence chatbots mimic human collective behaviour
reason: The paper is relevant to collective dynamics in online settings, but under the conservative boundary it lacks strong evidence of an admissible Core environment. It is better removed from the active Phase 1 working set.

title: DeMAC: Enhancing Multi-Agent Coordination with Dynamic DAG and Manager-Player Feedback
reason: The title and seed note point to a coordination architecture rather than a socially situated multi-agent environment paper. It should not consume more Phase 1 screening effort.
